# <span id="aanchor316"></span> Analysis Overrides

Standalone samples are also used in FLOWCAL in an operation called Sample Override. The user can do a Sample Override on Meter Batches and Standalone Tickets. A meter or location can be assigned to have an LQ applied, but the user can choose to do a sample override and assign a specific standalone sample to a meter batch or a liquid inventory or tank location.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 454;height: 368;" />

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Apply Sample to batch">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Apply Sample to a Batch</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Apply Sample to batch">

To perform a sample override on meter batch tickets, select one or more batches from the Volume Editor, right-click and hover over the Batch menu item, then select Sample Override. A Sample Assignment Window will appear where the user can choose between Source Quality analyses, or Sample Quality analyses. To apply a sample quality:

1.  Select the **Sample Quality** radio button.
2.  Choose a time frame that encompasses the sample to be applied.
3.  Click **Refresh**.
4.  Check the **Selection** checkbox for the sample to apply.
5.  Choose an edit reason.
6.  Choose whether to apply the sample as C6+, C7+, C8+, C9+ or C10+.
7.  Select an Apply Density value from an LQ sample (API Degrees, Absolute Density, or Relative Density) to be used in the apply process for tickets (not available for meters).
8.  Click **OK**.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Apply Sample to Ticket">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Apply Sample to a Standalone Ticket</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Apply Sample to Ticket">

The same sample override operation can also be performed on standalone tickets:

1.  Select one or more tickets from the Ticket Search or Ticket Editor window.
2.  Right-click and select **Attach Analysis**.
3.  Select the **Sample Quality** radio button.
4.  Choose a time frame that encompasses the sample to be applied.
5.  Click **Refresh**.
6.  Check the **Selection** checkbox for the sample to apply.
7.  Choose an edit reason.
8.  Choose whether to apply the sample as C6+, C7+, C8+, C9+ or C10+.
9.  Select an Apply Density value from an LQ sample (API Degrees, Absolute Density, or Relative Density) to be used in the apply process for tickets (not available for meters).
10. Click **OK**.

</div>
